entries.speaker: Occurrences of a Fusion Alarm
entries.en: [clr 2]Winning battles may trigger a Fusion Alarm.[clr 27][n]Successive wins increase the chances, but each[n]Alarm decreases them. Several can occur in one day.

entries.speaker: Occurrences of a Fusion Alarm
entries.en: Go to the Velvet Room during a Fusion Alarm and[n]try to fuse a powerful Persona.
